education.details: Specialisation: Risk Management, Innovation, Corporate Sustainability

certifications: IBM – Python for Data Science, AI & Development (2025)
ICAgile Certified Professional: Agile Project & Delivery Management (2023)

base_sections.career_profile: Product Manager with 9+ years of experience delivering SaaS, data, AI and enterprise technology solutions across agritech, retail, manufacturing and public sector environments. Proven track record of driving product strategy, roadmap execution and digital transformation initiatives that improve customer outcomes, operational efficiency and revenue growth. Experienced in leading cross-functional teams, managing product lifecycles, translating complex business requirements into scalable solutions and delivering measurable results, including an 8% revenue uplift, 30% reduction in planning effort, 25% faster approval times and platform scaling from 2,000 to 8,000 users. Skilled in Agile delivery, stakeholder management, product discovery, data analytics and enterprise platforms, with expertise spanning AWS, Azure, Dynamics 365, SaaS integrations and AI-enabled products.

areas_of_expertise.title: Product Strategy & Roadmap Ownership
areas_of_expertise.description: Defining product vision, prioritising initiatives, balancing short and long-term objectives, and aligning delivery with business goals, customer needs and measurable outcomes.

areas_of_expertise.title: AI-Powered Solutions & Automation
areas_of_expertise.description: Applying AI, machine learning and automation technologies to streamline processes, improve decision-making and deliver enhanced customer and operational outcomes.

areas_of_expertise.title: Agile Delivery & MVP Development
areas_of_expertise.description: Leading Agile product delivery, backlog management, sprint planning and MVP execution, using iterative development to rapidly validate ideas and create business value.

areas_of_expertise.title: Customer Discovery & User Research
areas_of_expertise.description: Conducting customer interviews, journey mapping, usability testing and discovery activities to uncover unmet needs, validate opportunities and inform product strategy.

areas_of_expertise.title: Customer Discovery, Market Research & Validation
areas_of_expertise.description: Conducting customer interviews, market analysis, competitor research and product discovery activities to identify opportunities, validate assumptions and inform product strategy.

areas_of_expertise.title: Experimentation, Feature Testing & Rapid Prototyping
areas_of_expertise.description: Designing and executing product experiments including false-door tests, prototypes, A/B testing and MVPs to validate demand, reduce risk and guide investment decisions.

areas_of_expertise.title: Requirements Elicitation & Scope Management
areas_of_expertise.description: Facilitating workshops, stakeholder interviews and discovery sessions to capture requirements, align expectations, define scope and translate business needs into actionable delivery outcomes.

areas_of_expertise.title: Performance Measurement & Hypothesis-Driven Product Management
areas_of_expertise.description: Defining success metrics, KPIs and outcome-based objectives, using hypotheses, experimentation and data analysis to evaluate product performance and inform decision-making.

areas_of_expertise.title: Business Case Development & Value Realisation
areas_of_expertise.description: Assessing opportunities, defining business cases, evaluating investment decisions and measuring realised value against strategic and commercial objectives.

areas_of_expertise.title: Product Analytics & Growth Optimisation
areas_of_expertise.description: Using behavioural analytics, funnels, experimentation and customer insights to improve adoption, engagement, retention and business performance.

areas_of_expertise.title: Product Launch & Go-To-Market Strategy
areas_of_expertise.description: Partnering with stakeholders to plan launches, coordinate change activities, drive adoption and maximise product success in market.

areas_of_expertise.title: End-to-End Product Lifecycle Management
areas_of_expertise.description: Managing products from discovery and validation through delivery, adoption, optimisation and retirement, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and customer value.

areas_of_expertise.title: Data Analysis & Insights (SQL, Python)
areas_of_expertise.description: Leveraging quantitative and qualitative data, analytics and reporting to identify trends, measure impact and support evidence-based product decisions.

areas_of_expertise.title: Data Products & Analytics Platforms
areas_of_expertise.description: Defining and delivering data-driven products, analytics capabilities and reporting solutions that enable business intelligence, operational visibility and strategic decision-making.

areas_of_expertise.title: API Design & Systems Integration (REST, SOAP)
areas_of_expertise.description: Delivering APIs and system integrations that improve interoperability, streamline business processes and support scalable digital ecosystems.

areas_of_expertise.title: Cloud Platforms & Solution Architecture (AWS)
areas_of_expertise.description: Working with cloud-native technologies including AWS Lambda, ECS, APIs and event-driven architectures to support scalable, resilient and cost-effective product solutions.

areas_of_expertise.title: Software Delivery, CI/CD & Release Management
areas_of_expertise.description: Collaborating with engineering teams to manage release pipelines, deployment processes, quality assurance and continuous delivery practices that enable reliable product delivery.

areas_of_expertise.title: Stakeholder Engagement & Cross-Functional Leadership
areas_of_expertise.description: Building alignment across customers, executives, delivery teams and technical specialists, fostering collaboration to achieve strategic and operational objectives.

professional_experience.title: Product Manager (Agile Business Analyst)
professional_experience.summary: Drive innovation through the development of AI-powered solutions using AWS Bedrock, including fertiliser intelligence and natural language analytics platforms that convert complex agricultural and operational data into actionable insights. Enhance security, user accessibility and customer experience for more than 8,000 farm connections by leading the implementation of Single Sign-On (SSO) across four integrated SaaS platforms. Accelerate delivery of customer-focused solutions by partnering with stakeholders, engineering teams and end users to define product strategy, prioritise high-value initiatives and translate business requirements into successful product outcomes.

achievements.achievement: Led the strategy and delivery of an AI-powered fertiliser analysis solution, automating statement ingestion, nutrient extraction and nitrogen reporting to improve operational efficiency and customer decision-making.

Defined and delivered an AI-powered natural language analytics capability that enabled non-technical users to access business insights through conversational queries, accelerating data-driven decision-making.

supporting_details.business_problem: Business users were reliant on technical teams to access data and answer operational questions.

achievements.achievement: Reduced farm planning effort by 30% through ownership of the product roadmap and delivery of predictive analytics capabilities within a SaaS herd management platform.
Scaled the organisation's agricultural data ecosystem from 2,000 to 8,000 connected farms with zero service disruption, significantly increasing the reach and value of customer insights.
Drove a cloud optimisation programme that reduced infrastructure and data ingestion costs while improving platform scalability and operational efficiency.

initiatives: Migrated suitable workloads from Lambda to ECS

achievements.achievement: Led a three-month cross-functional data remediation programme to resolve four years of accumulated data quality issues affecting more than 5,000 farms within a major UK retail supply chain.
Owned the delivery of an Easy Dairy integration capability that enabled automated farm data exchange for more than 2,000 farms.

professional_experience.title: Senior Business Analyst
professional_experience.summary: Owned backlog prioritisation, roadmap execution and requirements delivery for Anvil, an in-house Order Management System (OMS) and CRM platform supporting critical sales and fulfilment operations. Partnered with business stakeholders, engineering teams and technology vendors to define product improvements, optimise operational processes and deliver strategic initiatives that improved revenue, customer experience and operational efficiency.

achievements.achievement: Delivered an 8% revenue uplift by defining, prioritising and leading the delivery of a hybrid multi-warehouse order management capability, enabling more efficient fulfilment and increased order flexibility across multiple sites.

supporting_details.business_problem: Customers and internal teams required greater flexibility when fulfilling orders across multiple warehouse locations.

achievements.achievement: Owned roadmap planning and backlog prioritisation for strategic ERP modernisation initiatives, helping accelerate the organisation's migration from Microsoft Navision to Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations.

Served as Scrum Master for a cross-functional delivery team of six developers and two QA specialists, improving sprint predictability, delivery cadence and collaboration across business and technology stakeholders.

Led requirements discovery and solution design activities for customer-facing and operational improvements, translating complex business needs into actionable user stories, product requirements and delivery roadmaps.
Partnered with engineering teams to improve platform scalability, messaging reliability and data performance through enhancements to Azure-based services and Cosmos DB data architecture.

Collaborated with operational and commercial stakeholders to identify process improvement opportunities, prioritise high-value initiatives and deliver changes that improved efficiency and supported business growth.

professional_experience.title: Product Owner / Business Analyst
professional_experience.summary: Owned product backlogs, prioritisation and feature delivery for a SaaS customer engagement platform, partnering with retail clients, engineering teams and third-party technology providers to deliver scalable solutions that improved customer experience, marketing effectiveness and operational performance. Led product discovery, requirements definition and release planning activities, ensuring product investments aligned with client objectives, user needs and technical feasibility.

achievements.achievement: Delivered complex SaaS integrations across POS, SAP and loyalty ecosystems for major retail clients including Z Energy, Caltex and Daiso, improving customer targeting, campaign effectiveness and operational efficiency.

Defined and delivered a unified loyalty platform that consolidated three disparate customer data sources into a single customer view, enabling more personalised marketing and improved business decision-making.

supporting_details.business_problem: Customer information was fragmented across multiple systems, limiting visibility and reducing the effectiveness of marketing initiatives.

achievements.achievement: Reduced high-impact production defects by 40% by introducing stronger quality assurance practices, improving requirements clarity and aligning development and testing activities throughout the delivery lifecycle.

responsibilities: Partnered with development and test teams

achievements.achievement: Reduced regression testing effort by 60% and increased test coverage by 30% through the introduction of automation initiatives and risk-based testing practices, improving release confidence and delivery efficiency.
Partnered with retail clients to identify process improvement opportunities and define product enhancements that improved operational efficiency, customer experience and long-term platform adoption.

Established high-quality product documentation and API governance practices by maintaining API specifications and integration standards, improving consistency across internal and external development teams.

Strengthened team capability and delivery effectiveness by providing functional training and knowledge sharing for Technical Analysts and support teams, improving operational support and reducing dependency on key individuals.

professional_experience.title: Business Analyst
professional_experience.summary: Improved team velocity and delivery lead times by serving as Scrum Master for IoT and software development teams. Gathered and translated business requirements into user stories and functional specifications, ensuring successful solution delivery. Facilitated backlog refinement, sprint planning and stakeholder engagement to align product outcomes with business objectives.
achievements: Reduced licensing approval times by 25%; delivered SaaS solutions that automated workflows for public sector clients.
